name: edit_and_verify
description: Apply a fix and confirm it landed. Mutation is 13% of real tool calls and every read-only scenario misses it.
prompt: Fix the cache-hit bug in cache.py so a hit returns the cached value, then confirm the file on disk.

edits.old:
if key in cache:
        return None
edits.new:
if key in cache:
        return cache[key]

respond.content: cache.py now returns cache[key] on a hit; misses still load and store.
